census.rule: every (q, k, p) with q <= qmax prime, k <= kmax even, k < p < pmax prime, p >= 5, p != q, p !| q^2 - 1 is examined; a cell is skipped as trivial when the generic charpoly is squarefree mod p (every m is then a single Q_p-orbit with eta^B = 1) and no level raising congruence with the level-one form is possible (p !| a_q(g)^2 - q^{k-2}(q+1)^2); emitted cells keep only the blocks with a congruence or an old congruence
